personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility typography (Space Grotesk + Satoshi)
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply technical command center where security meets absolute AI integration—Axon isn't just an addition, it's the core.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for cinematic feel, tight and structural padding within data cards.

do's: Use intense blur over the glowing hero background.
Use translucent tinted bases (brandTertiary) under glass cards to ensure foreground readability.
Apply glass to sticky headers, feature cards, and the Axon core visual container.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Never rely on blur alone for contrast; always include a translucent base layer.

screens.name: Landing
screens.purpose: A high-conversion, visually striking landing page introducing Axon as the core of AdvisorOS.

states.error: Standard subtle error state with retry button.

screens.layout:
1. Hero: Center-aligned typography 'La nostra risposta: prepararci al futuro' floating above a massive animated glowing Axon orb. CTA 'ENTRA' sticky or prominent.
2. Mantra (Axon vs Standard AI): Side-by-side comparison on large screens, stacked on mobile. Left card shows generic AI, right card shows Axon deeply embedded in the CRM with glowing neural lines.
3. Modulistica (OCR): A staggered layout showing document upload leading to structured green glowing data fields. Highlight zero-typing.
4. Pronto All'uso: Text-heavy but highly styled block emphasizing proprietary OS and pre-configured deployment.
5. Modularity: A grid of 4-6 toggle cards (Agenda, Contratti, Corsi, Palestra Aziendale). Toggling them triggers a brandPrimary glow, demonstrating customizability.
6. Footer: Clean, centered contact info@advisoros.it and final CTA.

hero_orb_background.alt: Dark cinematic abstract green glowing orb background representing Axon core

glass_module_texture.alt: Dark luxury frosted glass texture for modular cards

instructions_to_main_agent: The page is a single scrollable view (landing.tsx). Must be responsive (works on <720px mobile and ~1000px max-width container on web).
Hero MUST strictly contain only the phrase 'La nostra risposta: prepararci al futuro' and 1-2 powerful slogans to invite a click. No standard title or logo in the center.
Implement an animated, fluid glowing orb in the Hero using react-native-reanimated and expo-blur to represent Axon. It should feel alive and reactive if possible.
Use Dark-First Utility typography (Space Grotesk + Satoshi) combined with Glass/Luxe Dark aesthetics (cinematic lighting, blurred panels, jewel tone brandPrimary).
Use EXACT Italian copy derived from the prompt. For Mantra: 'Non un'IA aggiunta. Un'IA nata nel CRM. Axon protegge la tua privacy. I dati rimangono esclusivamente tuoi.'
For Modulistica (OCR): 'Zero digitazione. Solo azione. Scatta una foto, carica un PDF. Axon compila tutto per te.' Include visual of OCR auto-populating fields.
For Modularity: 'Costruisci il tuo ecosistema.' Show toggle switches (Agenda, Contratti, Corsi, Palestra Aziendale) that users can interact with.
For Pronto all'uso: 'Nessun bug. Nessuna configurazione. Sistema Operativo proprietario, fornito pre-configurato su richiesta.'
Retain the CTA 'ENTRA' and footer contact 'info@advisoros.it'.
All images used as background must include a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text readability.
Never use blue, indigo, or purple. Rely entirely on the Emerald (brandPrimary) against Obsidian (surface) for visual punch.
